quarantined_split.true_isolation_type: Job-Disjoint Test Set (Unseen Jobs, Known Candidates, Unseen Pairs)

quarantine_policy.policy_statement: held_out_test_v1.parquet has been historically exposed to multiple sequential model comparisons, hyperparameter evaluations, and checkpoint screenings. Consequently, it has lost blind out-of-sample quarantine integrity. It is formally quarantined and must NEVER be used for model selection, threshold calibration, architecture tuning, or claims of unbiased final generalization.
quarantine_policy.preservation_mandate: The original parquet split and historical prediction files are preserved unmodified in their versioned locations for scientific reproducibility. No historical files shall be deleted or rewritten.
quarantine_policy.replacement_prohibition: Engineering teams must NOT manufacture a replacement test set by randomly re-splitting or re-partitioning existing dataset pools and claiming external independence.

historical_sequential_evaluations.model_type: Supervised Baseline (Logistic Regression on SBERT + 25 features)
Supervised Stacking (Random Forest + Gradient Boosting + LR)
Self-Supervised Domain Adaptation on Djinni Corpus
Final Automated Pipeline Challenger (LightGBM Optuna Tuned)

direct_label_leakage.findings: Ground-truth test labels were never provided as input features or training targets to any model. Pseudo-labels were sourced from external candidate pools.

adaptive_test_reuse_bias.findings: Evaluating 6 distinct configurations sequentially against the same 1,759 test rows created Freedman post-selection bias. The best-performing configuration (50.26% or 51.05%) reflects adaptive selection over test evaluations rather than unbiased out-of-sample generalization.
